name: BRIGANDINE ABYSS
description:
About This Game

Story・Intro

Once upon a time, the world was saved by the Brigandine.

This arcane armor, forged by the great sorcerer Lunadea, brought an end to the ambitions of the Abyssloa Empire.

200 years have since passed, and the continent’s current greatest superpower, the Kingdom of Solginat, has grown into a disquieting presence. In response, the rulers of various nations, spearheaded by the queen of Mysteine—a realm that carries on Lunadea’s will—gather together to issue a formal denunciation…

Game Modes

Story Mode

Experience the unique stories of six distinct nations, each set in motion by the rebirth of the Abyssloa Empire.

Mission Mode

Select from 24 nations to play as, each with its own win condition.

Strengthen Your Nation While Time Allows

During Organization Phases, allied troops can be strengthened in preparation for the upcoming battles.

Efficient task management will prove key in maximizing your forces’ improvements.

Invade Neighboring Nations to Bolster Your Own

During Attack Phases, other countries can be invaded to obtain resources or strengthen personnel.

Whether to invade or not is for you to decide.

Employ Tactics to Command Troops and Annihilate Foes

Battles are turn-based and take place on a hexagonal grid.

Focus down enemy leaders to force a retreat or defeat each unit one by one. Strategy is in your hands.
short_desc: Play as one of six factions to confront the Abyssloa Empire. Command your troops, develop your bases, and take control of the continent of Meltitea in this tactical strategy RPG!
